title: Create passenger account
inputs: New email; name Test Rider; phone 9876543210; password Journey123.
expected: 201; normalized unique email; PASSENGER role; no password/hash in response.

title: Reject duplicate and invalid registration
inputs: Existing email with changed case; missing phone; malformed JSON.
steps: Submit missing phone then malformed JSON.
expected: 409 duplicate; 400 invalid; no extra accounts; field errors identify invalid data.

title: Valid login
inputs: Registered passenger and correct password.
steps: Use returned token as Authorization: Bearer on GET /api/users/me.
expected: 200 login/profile; opaque token is usable; stored token_hash differs from raw bearer.

title: Invalid login and lockout
inputs: Unknown email; wrong password; five failures for one account.
steps: Advance injected clock past 300 seconds and retry.
expected: Generic 401 responses match; lock returns 429; after expiry valid login succeeds.

title: Reject invalid session
inputs: Missing, garbage and expired tokens.
steps: Request protected booking/profile endpoints with each token.
expected: 401; no protected state disclosed or changed.

title: Logout and password session revocation
inputs: Two valid sessions for same user.
steps: Logout one session and request profile.
Change password using current password from remaining session.
Verify other sessions revoked and current session retained.
expected: Logged-out token fails; password update keeps current session and revokes others.

title: Search ordered route
inputs: Fixture Alpha → Beta; future valid date D.
steps: Compare returned train and route against fixture.
expected: 200 matches forward stop order; reverse route cannot match that forward-only schedule.

title: Inspect schedule and fares
inputs: Known train ID with ordered stops and class fares.
steps: Compare number/name, stops, times, duration and fares.
expected: Summary and details match fixture; stop order/day offsets and class fare values preserved.

title: No results and invalid criteria
inputs: Unknown route; absent date; invalid calendar date.
expected: 200 with empty list for no matches; 400 with field errors for invalid criteria.

title: Filter and sort
inputs: Multiple trains with different class, fare and departure values.
steps: Search using class, maxFare and departure range.
expected: Only eligible trains returned in requested order; invalid filter yields field error.

title: Class inventory equation
inputs: Train class capacity C; reserve n seats on date D.
steps: GET availability for D and D+1.
expected: Available seats are C−n on D and unaffected on D+1.

title: Sold-out and bad availability query
inputs: Class with zero remaining capacity; invalid date; unknown ID.
steps: Request invalid date and unknown train.
expected: Zero available; sold-out preview rejected; invalid date 400 and missing train 404.

title: Preview without mutation
inputs: Logged-in passenger; valid train/date/class; two passengers.
steps: Inspect total fare, count and availability.
expected: 200; totalFare=2×farePerPassenger; no booking or reservation created.

title: Passenger field boundaries
inputs: Names with digits/script, age 0/121/non-numeric, invalid gender.
steps: POST preview and confirm with invalid data.
expected: 400; correct passenger index and field; no partial booking.

title: Stale preview conflict
inputs: One remaining seat; two logged-in passengers.
steps: Preview one seat for user A.
expected: B succeeds; A gets 409; no A booking/passenger/reservation/success audit.

title: Distinct persisted PNR
inputs: Capacity for multiple bookings.
steps: Query bookings table and retrieve tickets by PNR.
expected: Each PNR is a distinct ten-digit string stored on its booking.

title: Seat decrement exactly once
inputs: Capacity 10; three valid passengers.
expected: 201; three distinct seats; one quantity-3 linked reservation; availability drops from 10 to 7.

title: Passenger count boundaries
inputs: Passenger arrays of size 0, 1, 6 and 7.
steps: Preview each array on class with sufficient seats.
Confirm valid boundaries in isolated fixtures.
expected: 0 and 7 rejected; 1 and 6 accepted if all fields valid and capacity sufficient.

title: Owner ticket by PNR
inputs: Confirmed booking; owner bearer token.
steps: Compare PNR, date, class, train, passengers, seats and fare with confirmation.
expected: 200 correct ticket; unknown PNR 404; URL uses PNR, not numeric internal ID.

title: Isolated newest-first history
inputs: Two accounts; multiple confirmed/cancelled bookings.
steps: Create bookings for both users and cancel one own booking.
expected: New account list empty; each user sees only own records newest-first including cancelled ticket details.

title: Eligible owner cancellation
inputs: Own confirmed future booking outside 24-hour cutoff.
steps: GET cancellation quote using numeric booking id.
expected: Quote eligible; cancellation 200; ticket CANCELLED with cancelledAt and recorded refund.

title: Refund quote and floor rule
inputs: Booking totalFare; default 90 percent and configured alternate percentage.
steps: GET quote and verify no row mutation.
expected: Quote/persisted refund equal integer floor; configured percentage honored; no payment operation occurs.

title: Restore own seats once
inputs: Two bookings on same train/date/class.
expected: Only first booking quantity restored; repeated cancellation 409; freed seats reusable without active duplicates.

title: Reject late or repeated cancellation
inputs: Booking within cutoff; already cancelled booking; alternate cutoff.
steps: Request quote and cancel for late booking.
expected: Late quote ineligible, zero refund; cancellation 409; repeated cancellation 409; policy honored.

title: Cancellation rollback
inputs: Confirmed booking; injected inventory deletion failure.
expected: No partial cancellation, refund, seat restoration or success audit survives failure.

title: Salted password storage
inputs: Two accounts with identical valid password.
steps: Verify correct/wrong password; inspect API responses.
expected: Only PBKDF2 hashes stored; distinct salts; correct verifies, wrong fails; no password/hash disclosure.

title: Current role authorization
inputs: Passenger, admin and revoked sessions.
steps: Attempt admin list/create/update/audit with passenger/anonymous tokens.
Change admin role in DB and retry existing token.
expected: 401/403 as appropriate; changed role enforced immediately; registration remains PASSENGER.

title: Ownership despite spoofed fields
inputs: A owns booking; B has valid session and knows id/PNR.
steps: As B read ticket, quote and cancel A booking.
Supply A owner id in body.
Call service owner check under test.
expected: 404; no disclosure or state change; service enforces actual owner inside transaction.

title: Live TLS and configuration rejection
inputs: Temporary local certificate/key and explicit client trust; standalone executable.
steps: Connect using trusted SSLContext and record negotiated protocol.
Start with only one TLS path.
expected: Trusted local TLS connection succeeds; selected system run negotiates TLS 1.3; incomplete configuration fails startup.

title: Injection and unsafe input
inputs: SQL/script strings; control characters; wrong JSON types.
steps: Inspect browser rendering of dynamic content.
expected: Controlled rejection; no SQL execution, unintended write or script execution; dynamic content escaped/text assigned.

title: Secrets absent from diagnostics
inputs: Distinct password/token markers; requests with query/control characters.
steps: Run login and protected API calls.
Search markers and inspect browser request URLs.
expected: No raw password/token in logs, URLs or errors; access targets omit query values and control characters.

title: Hash upgrade and invalid encoded values
inputs: Weaker stored PBKDF2 hash; malformed and extreme iteration counts.
steps: Login successfully against weaker valid hash.
expected: Successful login upgrades weak hash; invalid/extreme values rejected without unbounded work.

title: Create and update complete train
inputs: Admin; new train number; ordered stops; classes/capacity/fares.
steps: Recheck search/details and old booking fare.
expected: Valid changes visible; existing booking fare snapshot retained.

title: Deny unauthorized admin access
inputs: No token, passenger token and revoked admin token.
steps: Attempt admin reads and writes with each.
expected: Anonymous/revoked 401; passenger 403; no write.

title: Deactivate with existing bookings
inputs: Active train and confirmed booking; stale preview.
steps: Read existing ticket/history and cancel eligible booking.
expected: Train hidden; new confirmation rejected; existing ticket/history/cancel work; inactive state persists.

title: Atomic validation and update guards
inputs: Duplicate train number; invalid stops; referenced class; capacity below assigned seats.
expected: 400/409 as implemented; no partial write; referenced class removal/capacity shrink rejected.

title: Timestamped transition audit
inputs: One successful booking followed by cancellation.
steps: Query audit_events and admin audit API.
expected: Exactly one event for each successful transition; actor and identifiers match persisted ticket.

title: Secret-safe audit and access log
inputs: Booking/cancellation with distinct credential markers.
steps: Read generated audit fields and captured access logs.
expected: Audit has identifiers/timestamp/refund only; no credentials or bearer values.

title: No false success audit
inputs: Failed booking and injected cancellation transaction failure.
expected: No success event for rolled-back/failed operation.

title: Separate search and booking p90
inputs: Standalone server; local fixture; four clients; 20 searches and 20 bookings.
steps: Run system runner on isolated DB.
Record latency per request and status.
Compute separate p90 for search and booking and retain raw samples.
Inspect selected UI flow responsiveness separately.
expected: Both p90 ≤3 seconds; no failed requests silently discarded; record machine/load; no production throughput inference.

title: Concurrent booking consistency
inputs: Limited capacity; competing clients against same train/date/class.
steps: Query active seat assignments, reservation sums and capacity.
expected: No duplicate active seat; no overselling; successful quantities reconcile with inventory.

title: Database duplicate-seat defense
inputs: Two confirmed bookings with same inventory key.
steps: Insert passenger seat on first booking.
Directly attempt same seat for second.
expected: Trigger rejects duplicate active seat; existing allocation preserved.

title: Safe validation and server errors
inputs: Malformed JSON; unknown endpoint; injected database failure.
expected: Controlled JSON errors; no database/stack/credential detail; no partial mutation.

title: Body and identifier boundaries
inputs: Body >64 KiB; oversized numeric ID; wrong JSON field types.
expected: Controlled rejection (413 oversized payload or safe endpoint validation); no crash and health remains available.

title: Restart and abrupt-stop persistence
inputs: File-backed isolated DB; committed booking/cancellation/audit state.
steps: Start real executable, write committed state and stop cleanly.
Restart same database and compare state.
Write committed state, terminate abruptly, restart.
Run PRAGMA integrity_check and reconcile inventory/audit.
expected: Committed records retained after both stops; integrity_check=ok; available capacity and active reservations reconcile.

title: Responsive passenger workflow
inputs: Mobile 390×844; desktop 1366×900; browser against real server.
steps: At mobile, search, preview, confirm ticket, view and cancel; inspect overflow/reachability.
At desktop, register/login/search and inspect overflow.
Record unexercised desktop steps as not independently repeated.
expected: Selected mobile booking/cancel and desktop registration/login/search are usable without horizontal page overflow; full desktop booking/cancel remains a separate planned repetition.
